content: QEMU virt official doc: default CPU is cortex-a15 (32-bit) so aarch64 guests MUST pass -cpu cortex-a53/57/72/etc. RAM starts at 0x40000000, flash at 0x0. For bare-metal (ELF) boots the DTB is placed at start of RAM; for Linux-boot-protocol images the DTB address arrives in x0. Board has PL011 UART(s), selectable GICv2/v3/v4 (gic-version machine option; v2 limits to 8 CPUs), 32 virtio-mmio transports. Machine is versioned (virt-5.0 etc.) so device addresses other than RAM/flash can move between QEMU versions - read the DTB.
